facebook.caption:
1,114 people rated a rainforest. 4.2 stars.

Phu Quoc National Park is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve covering most of the island's interior. Evergreen forest, rare flora, endemic wildlife, and oceanic species you won't find anywhere else in Vietnam.

Most tourists stay on the beach their whole trip. The park sits empty.

Rent a motorbike and go north. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Riding into Phu Quoc National Park at dawn. No crowds, no resort pools. Just 37,000 hectares of UNESCO rainforest that most tourists on this island never enter.
